consequence.classification: HARMLESS_ALL when maximum simulated landing error <= 3 mm; CONSEQUENTIAL_SOME when it exceeds 3 mm; CONSEQUENTIAL_ALL when it exceeds 7 mm. UNKNOWN is consequential for the gate.
consequence.gate: undetected_consequential_some_count must equal zero; old 33-gap receipt remains unchanged.

decision_rules: Do not alter or rescore the original 33 gaps.
Report silhouette-only, touch-only, fused, harmless, and consequential counts.
The external-observer simulation passes only with zero fused undetected consequential-some cases.
The exploratory rehearsal passes coverage only when A-F each emit predicted telemetry; it cannot pass installed collision or readiness gates.

fusion.rule: DETECTED when either independent observer robustly detects; no servo self-report receives geometry-detection credit

limitations: Observer scale, detection, noise, safe-region, and paired-error values are unmeasured exploratory ranges.
Analytic silhouette shifts do not qualify real camera segmentation or calibration.
Touch-surface simulation does not select or qualify physical hardware.
Candidate collision geometry is uninstalled and currently reports collision/blocker cases.

paired_gap_model.reason: frozen representative high endpoint before extension results

silhouette_observer.robust_detection_rule: minimum projected shift across hover poses and pixel scale must exceed maximum detectable boundary shift

touch_surface_observer.robust_detection_rule: minimum landing shift must exceed maximum noise times maximum multiplier
